warn_box.text:
If you delete your account, it will be permanently removed along with all your settings. Your created tasks will be retained, but will no longer be linked to your name. Announcements will also be retained. If you want to remove tasks or announcements, please delete them manually before closing your account.

You can create a new account at any time, but previously added content will no longer be linked to your account, so you will no longer be able to access it.
warn_box.title: Delete Account permanently?
